name: AI Trip Planner
description: A Streamlit itinerary planner using OpenAI tool calling, verified place data, optional travel-guide retrieval, interactive maps, and PDF or JSON export. Optional model and place services can fail independently of itinerary planning.

name: IntakeWise
description: A responsive organizer for medication, supplements, vitamins, and custom intake schedules. Account holders can manage a private item catalog, review schedules in a calendar, and adjust or skip individual intakes.

name: Nomadant Tech Store
description: An academic full-stack electronics storefront with GitHub OAuth sign-in and Stripe test-mode checkout. Its React storefront and Node.js REST API are deployed separately.

name: AI Engineering Lessons
description: A collection of AI, machine-learning, and RAG learning projects. It includes a historical archive of an exercise deploying Microsoft's Azure Search and OpenAI sample; the repository states that the model service has been retired.

name: Full Stack Engineering Lessons
description: Coursework and projects spanning frontend, backend, APIs, databases, authentication, testing, and Git. The repository includes RESTful Restaurants and an e-commerce REST API.

name: RESTful Restaurants
description: A responsive application for organizing restaurants into categories, maintaining a starred list, and managing records through an Express API backed by Supabase.

name: Tutare
description: A bilingual portfolio for creative workshops and event services, with facilitator profiles and an artwork gallery. Spanish is the default language, with English available throughout the site.

name: Python Lessons
description: Python exercises, university assignments, data-analysis notebooks, and personal learning projects, including an interactive multimodal commute-map project.

name: Unbound Root
description: A static, multilingual educational website about cyberspace, digital safety and cybersecurity awareness for families and everyday internet users.

name: HusKey Manager Security Coursework
description: A UW course repository centered on learning to identify and remediate security issues in a sample password-manager application.
